create_BlenderDataset_for_split: create a BlenderDataset instance with a config and split to load Blender scene data
create_BlenderLightfieldDataset: create a BlenderLightfieldDataset instance with a config to load lightfield data from Blender scenes
create_DenseBlenderDataset: create a DenseBlenderDataset instance with a config to load a dense subset of Blender scene frames
get_rays_BlenderDataset: get rays origin and direction for a given frame index using BlenderDataset get_rays method
get_intrinsics_BlenderDataset: get the camera intrinsics matrix K from a BlenderDataset instance using get_intrinsics method
